system.description: The biothaumaturge imbues an intact, dead plant or animal no larger than a dog with part of her own life essence, animating it to follow simple mindless instructions until destroyed. The creation retains its living Strength and Stamina Traits, loses one Dexterity Trait, and has zero Mental and Social Traits (rendering it immune to Dominate and Social powers). It has half its living wound levels, crumbles to dust in sunlight, and suffers double fire damage. Animating a corpse requires seven days of preparation and a successful Static Mental Challenge.
